Body.Content: Azure Machine Learning, a fully managed service for advanced analytics in the cloud, is now in public preview. Build advanced analytic web services in minutes and hours and eliminate much of the heavy lifting associated with deploying machine learning in modern data-driven applications. For more information, visit the Machine Learning Center . For a comprehensive look at pricing, visit the Machine Learning Pricing Details page.
